description: OPENS THE PUBLISH CARD RIGHT HERE for a post `prepare_post` has already staged: the user watches the actual video, picks the account, edits the caption, chooses the visibility, the interaction switches and the commercial disclosure, and presses ONE Post button. THAT CLICK POSTS IT: the card calls `publish_post` itself. CALL IT IMMEDIATELY AFTER `prepare_post` ON ANY CLIENT THAT RENDERS CARDS, then say one short line (the post is on screen) and STOP. Do not recite the caption, list the privacy options, or ask 'public or friends-only?' or whether they want it posted, and never re-confirm in chat: those are the card's. NEVER CALL `publish_post` FOR A POST YOU OPENED HERE: before the click it would send choices the user never made, and the click retires that id (`superseded`) and posts a fresh copy. After the click your context gets `aicut_publish` with the new `post_id` and its status; `get_post_status` with that id reads the outcome. Closing the card sends nothing. If no card renders (a terminal, a script), confirm in chat as `publish_post` describes. THIS CALL COSTS NOTHING AND SENDS NOTHING: it reads a post you already prepared. OUTPUT: the prepared post, for the card; do not paste or summarise it.

post_id.description: The `id` `prepare_post` returned; the card reads the post back from it.

name: review_post
title: Show the user the post before it goes out
